lines.line: The hand that presses the switch belongs to you, the visitor.
It is a skinned hand model from the WebXR input profiles, with a bone for every knuckle.
The fingertip goes exactly where it is sent, and the rest of the hand hangs off it on springs.
When the hand speeds up or slows down, it tilts and twists, and the other fingers swing before they settle.
On the switch, the finger bends as she leans against it, and it jolts briefly each time she kicks.
The hand fades out at the wrist. Its shadow is dithered, so the shadow fades out in the same way.
